 Fraud crackdown makes ACA open enrollment harder
 WBUR
 Published November 11, 2026 at 10:50 AM CST
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Listen • 5:30
 Wayne Partlow/AP Pages from the U.S. Affordable Care Act health insurance website healthcare.gov are seen on a computer screen in Williamsburg, Va., Oct. 31, 2026. (Wayne Partlow/AP) 
 Signing up for a new health insurance plan through the federal marketplace is a bit more challenging this year, as applicants face additional requirements to prove they aren’t committing fraud.
 Here & Now ‘s Robin Young speaks with Julie Appleby , a correspondent for KFF Health News, about how the changes are affecting Affordable Care Act open enrollment.
